# Solana Token Metadata API

> Explore SPL and Token-2022 token stats with the Vybe Solana API: metadata, market cap, top holders, top traders, trade history and exportable analytics.

Live demo of the Vybe Solana API. The linked docs pages are the Markdown versions.

## Demo
- [Solana Token Metadata API](https://solana-token-metadata-api.vybenetwork.com/): Explore SPL and Token-2022 token stats with the Vybe Solana API: metadata, market cap, top holders, top traders, trade history and exportable analytics.
